facts.function: Lateral forearm bone; rotates around ulna in pronation/supination; main wrist articulation (distal fracture = Colles)
facts.attachments: Head with capitulum and radial notch of ulna; distally with scaphoid, lunate, and ulnar head

facts.function: Medial forearm bone; forms the stable hinge articulation at the elbow
facts.attachments: Trochlear notch with trochlea; radial notch with radial head; distal head with ulnar notch of radius

facts.function: Disc-shaped proximal radius that spins within annular ligament during pronation/supination
facts.attachments: Articulates with capitulum and radial notch of ulna; encircled by annular ligament

facts.function: Medial projection below radial neck; lever point for supination
facts.attachments: Insertion of biceps brachii tendon

facts.function: Distal end of ulna forming distal radioulnar joint
facts.attachments: Articulates with ulnar notch of radius; separated from carpus by articular disc (TFCC)

facts.function: Concavity on medial distal radius receiving ulnar head; site of distal radioulnar joint
facts.attachments: Articulates with head of ulna; articular disc attaches to its margin

facts.function: Lateral distal radial projection, extending farther distally than ulnar styloid; palpable at proximal anatomical snuffbox
facts.attachments: Brachioradialis inserts at its base; radial collateral ligament of wrist attaches

facts.function: Medial distal ulnar projection palpable posteromedially at wrist
facts.attachments: Ulnar collateral ligament of wrist; articular disc (TFCC) attaches near its base

facts.function: Proximal carpal row; scaphoid and lunate articulate with radius at the wrist
Most commonly fractured carpal (snuffbox tenderness); retrograde supply → proximal pole avascular necrosis or nonunion
facts.attachments: Articulates with radius, lunate, capitate, trapezium, trapezoid; tubercle anchors flexor retinaculum
facts.supply: Radial artery branches entering distally (retrograde flow)

facts.function: Most commonly dislocated carpal; anterior dislocation compresses median nerve in carpal tunnel
facts.attachments: Articulates with radius, scaphoid, triquetrum, capitate

facts.function: Pyramidal medial bone of proximal carpal row
facts.attachments: Articulates with lunate, hamate, pisiform; separated from ulna by articular disc

facts.function: Sesamoid bone in FCU tendon; medial wall of Guyon's canal
facts.attachments: Articulates with triquetrum; FCU insertion, flexor retinaculum, abductor digiti minimi origin

facts.function: Distal carpal row; articulates with metacarpal bases at carpometacarpal joints
Forms saddle-shaped thumb CMC joint; groove transmits FCR tendon
facts.attachments: Articulates with scaphoid, trapezoid, metacarpals I–II; tubercle anchors flexor retinaculum

facts.function: Smallest, wedge-shaped bone of distal carpal row
facts.attachments: Articulates with 2nd metacarpal, trapezium, scaphoid, capitate

facts.function: Largest carpal and first to ossify; keystone of carpal arch
facts.attachments: Articulates mainly with 3rd metacarpal; also lunate, scaphoid, trapezoid, hamate

facts.function: Hook forms lateral wall of Guyon's canal; hook fracture can injure ulnar nerve
facts.attachments: Articulates with metacarpals IV–V, triquetrum, capitate; hook anchors flexor retinaculum

facts.function: Five bones of the palm, numbered I (thumb) to V
Shortest, thickest metacarpal; mobile saddle joint permits thumb opposition
facts.attachments: Base with trapezium; APL inserts on base, opponens pollicis on shaft

facts.function: Longest metacarpal; nearly immobile CMC joint
facts.attachments: Base with trapezoid (plus trapezium, capitate); ECRL and FCR insert on base

facts.function: Styloid process at base; central immobile axis of hand for ab/adduction
facts.attachments: Base with capitate; ECRB inserts on base

facts.function: Slender metacarpal with slightly mobile CMC joint
facts.attachments: Base with capitate and hamate

facts.function: Most mobile medial metacarpal; neck fracture = boxer's fracture
facts.attachments: Base with hamate; ECU inserts on base

facts.function: 14 per hand: thumb has proximal and distal; digits 2–5 have proximal, middle, distal
Link metacarpals to distal digit; form MCP joints proximally
facts.attachments: Bases articulate with metacarpal heads (MCP); heads with middle phalanges (thumb: distal phalanx)

facts.function: Present in digits 2–5 only; between PIP and DIP joints
facts.attachments: FDS inserts on sides of middle phalanges

facts.function: Terminal phalanges supporting nail bed and fingertip pulp
facts.attachments: FDP inserts on bases (digits 2–5); FPL on thumb; extensor terminal tendon dorsally

facts.function: Pronation/supination: radius rotates around ulna at proximal and distal radioulnar pivot joints
facts.attachments: Interosseous membrane links radius and ulna shafts, transfers force radius → ulna, separates compartments

facts.function: Holds radial head in radial notch during rotation; subluxation = nursemaid's elbow
facts.attachments: Anterior and posterior margins of radial notch of ulna, encircling radial head

facts.function: Condyloid synovial joint: flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, circumduction
facts.attachments: Distal radius and articular disc ↔ scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum

facts.function: Thumb CMC is a mobile saddle joint; CMC 2–3 nearly immobile; CMC 4–5 slightly mobile
facts.attachments: Distal carpal row ↔ bases of metacarpals I–V

facts.function: Saddle joint allowing flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, opposition; common osteoarthritis site
facts.attachments: Trapezium ↔ base of 1st metacarpal

facts.function: Condyloid joints: flexion/extension and abduction/adduction; collateral ligaments taut in flexion
facts.attachments: Metacarpal heads ↔ bases of proximal phalanges; palmar plates anteriorly

facts.function: Hinge joints allowing flexion/extension only; PIP and DIP in digits 2–5, single IP in thumb
facts.attachments: Phalangeal heads ↔ bases of next distal phalanges; collateral ligaments and palmar plates

facts.function: Fibrous bands holding tendons against the wrist, preventing bowstringing
Roof of carpal tunnel; divided in carpal tunnel release
facts.attachments: Scaphoid and trapezium tubercles ↔ pisiform and hook of hamate

facts.function: Holds extensor tendons; septa divide them into six dorsal compartments
facts.attachments: Distal radius (lateral) ↔ ulnar styloid, triquetrum, pisiform (medial)

facts.function: Contains radial artery; floor is scaphoid and trapezium; tenderness suggests scaphoid fracture
facts.attachments: Bounded by APL and EPB tendons (lateral) and EPL tendon (medial)

facts.function: Transmits median nerve and 9 tendons (4 FDS, 4 FDP, FPL); compression → carpal tunnel syndrome
facts.attachments: Carpal bones form floor and walls; flexor retinaculum forms roof

facts.function: Transmits ulnar nerve and artery at wrist; compression (cyclists, hook of hamate fracture) → ulnar neuropathy
facts.attachments: Between pisiform (medial) and hook of hamate (lateral); roofed by palmar carpal ligament

facts.function: Pronates forearm; weakly flexes elbow; median nerve passes between its two heads
facts.attachments: Medial epicondyle (humeral head) and coronoid process (ulnar head) → mid lateral radius

facts.function: Flexes and abducts (radially deviates) wrist
facts.attachments: Medial epicondyle → base of 2nd metacarpal

facts.function: Weak wrist flexor; tenses palmar aponeurosis; absent in ~14%; tendon graft source
facts.attachments: Medial epicondyle → flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis

facts.function: Flexes and adducts (ulnar deviates) wrist; ulnar nerve enters forearm between its heads
facts.attachments: Medial epicondyle and olecranon/posterior ulna → pisiform, hook of hamate, 5th metacarpal

facts.function: Flexes PIP joints of digits 2–5; also MCP and wrist
facts.attachments: Medial epicondyle, coronoid process, anterior radius → shafts of middle phalanges of digits 2–5

facts.function: Only muscle flexing DIP joints of digits 2–5; also PIP, MCP, wrist; origin of lumbricals
facts.innervation: Medial half: ulnar nerve; lateral half: anterior interosseous nerve (C8–T1)
facts.attachments: Proximal anterior ulna and interosseous membrane → bases of distal phalanges of digits 2–5

facts.function: Flexes thumb at IP joint (and MCP)
facts.attachments: Anterior radius and interosseous membrane → base of distal phalanx of thumb

facts.function: Prime pronator of forearm; binds distal radius and ulna
facts.attachments: Distal anterior ulna → distal anterior radius

facts.function: Flexes elbow, strongest in midprone (thumb-up) position
facts.attachments: Lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus → base of radial styloid

facts.function: Extends and abducts wrist; key for fist clenching
facts.attachments: Lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus → dorsal base of 2nd metacarpal

facts.function: Extends and abducts wrist; origin implicated in lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow)
facts.attachments: Lateral epicondyle (common extensor origin) → dorsal base of 3rd metacarpal

facts.function: Extends digits 2–5 at MCP (IPs via extensor expansions); assists wrist extension
facts.attachments: Lateral epicondyle → extensor expansions of digits 2–5

facts.function: Extends 5th digit
facts.attachments: Lateral epicondyle → extensor expansion of 5th digit

facts.function: Extends and adducts (ulnar deviates) wrist
facts.attachments: Lateral epicondyle and posterior ulna → base of 5th metacarpal

facts.function: Supinates forearm (main supinator when elbow extended)
facts.innervation: Deep branch of radial nerve, which passes through it to become posterior interosseous nerve
facts.attachments: Lateral epicondyle, radial collateral and annular ligaments, supinator crest of ulna → proximal lateral radius

facts.function: Abducts and extends thumb at CMC; lateral snuffbox border; de Quervain tenosynovitis
facts.attachments: Posterior radius, ulna, interosseous membrane → base of 1st metacarpal

facts.function: Extends thumb at MCP (and CMC); lateral snuffbox border; de Quervain tenosynovitis with APL
facts.attachments: Posterior radius and interosseous membrane → base of proximal phalanx of thumb

facts.function: Extends thumb at IP (and MCP, CMC); hooks around dorsal (Lister) tubercle; medial snuffbox border
facts.attachments: Posterior middle ulna and interosseous membrane → base of distal phalanx of thumb

facts.function: Extends index finger independently (pointing); assists wrist extension
facts.attachments: Posterior distal ulna and interosseous membrane → extensor expansion of 2nd digit

facts.function: Form thenar eminence; position the thumb for opposition and grip
Abducts thumb; tests recurrent median nerve
facts.attachments: Flexor retinaculum, scaphoid and trapezium tubercles → lateral base of thumb proximal phalanx

facts.function: Flexes thumb at MCP joint
facts.innervation: Superficial head: recurrent branch of median nerve; deep head: often deep ulnar nerve
facts.attachments: Flexor retinaculum and trapezium tubercle → lateral base of thumb proximal phalanx

facts.function: Opposes thumb: flexes and medially rotates 1st metacarpal
facts.attachments: Flexor retinaculum and trapezium tubercle → lateral side of 1st metacarpal

facts.function: Adducts thumb; key for pinch grip (weakness → Froment sign)
facts.attachments: Oblique head: capitate, bases of MC II–III; transverse head: MC III shaft → medial base of thumb proximal phalanx

facts.function: Form hypothenar eminence; move the little finger
Abducts 5th digit
facts.attachments: Pisiform and FCU tendon → medial base of proximal phalanx of 5th digit

facts.function: Flexes 5th digit at MCP joint
facts.attachments: Hook of hamate and flexor retinaculum → medial base of proximal phalanx of 5th digit

facts.function: Draws 5th metacarpal anteriorly and rotates it toward thumb
facts.attachments: Hook of hamate and flexor retinaculum → medial border of 5th metacarpal

facts.function: Fine finger control: flex MCPs and extend IPs; interossei abduct and adduct digits
Flex MCP and extend IP joints of digits 2–5
facts.innervation: 1st–2nd: median nerve; 3rd–4th: deep branch of ulnar nerve
facts.attachments: FDP tendons → lateral sides of extensor expansions of digits 2–5

facts.function: Abduct digits from 3rd-digit axis (DAB); assist MCP flexion and IP extension
facts.attachments: Adjacent sides of metacarpals I–V → proximal phalanx bases and extensor expansions of digits 2–4

facts.function: Adduct digits 2, 4, 5 toward 3rd-digit axis (PAD); assist MCP flexion and IP extension
facts.attachments: Palmar surfaces of metacarpals II, IV, V → proximal phalanx bases and extensor expansions of same digits

facts.function: Motor to most anterior forearm flexors, thenar muscles, lateral two lumbricals; sensory to lateral palm and 3½ digits
facts.innervation: C5–T1, from lateral and medial cord roots
facts.attachments: Between pronator teres heads → deep to FDS → carpal tunnel → recurrent and digital branches

facts.function: Motor to FPL, lateral FDP, pronator quadratus; no cutaneous branch; lesion → cannot make OK sign
facts.innervation: C8–T1 fibers; branch of median nerve
facts.attachments: Arises from median nerve near pronator teres → descends on interosseous membrane with anterior interosseous artery

facts.function: Motor to thenar muscles (APB, FPB, OP); 'million-dollar nerve' at risk in carpal tunnel surgery
facts.attachments: Arises distal to flexor retinaculum and curves back (recurrent) into thenar eminence

facts.function: Motor to FCU, medial FDP, hypothenar muscles, interossei, medial lumbricals, adductor pollicis; sensory to medial 1½ digits
facts.attachments: Behind medial epicondyle → between FCU heads → with ulnar artery → Guyon's canal → superficial and deep branches

facts.function: Motor to arm and forearm extensors, brachioradialis, supinator; sensory to dorsolateral hand
facts.attachments: Anterior to lateral epicondyle between brachialis and brachioradialis → divides into superficial and deep branches

facts.function: Motor to ECRB and supinator; continues as posterior interosseous nerve
facts.attachments: Arises anterior to lateral epicondyle → pierces supinator (arcade of Frohse) into posterior compartment

facts.function: Motor to posterior forearm extensors (ED, EDM, ECU, APL, EPB, EPL, EI); lesion → finger drop without sensory loss
facts.innervation: C7–C8; motor, plus sensory to wrist joint
facts.attachments: Continuation of deep radial branch after supinator → runs with posterior interosseous artery

facts.function: Sensory to dorsolateral hand, thumb, and lateral 2½ digits proximally (first dorsal web space)
facts.innervation: Purely cutaneous sensory branch of radial nerve
facts.attachments: Runs deep to brachioradialis beside radial artery → emerges dorsally in distal forearm

facts.function: Supplies lateral forearm, thumb, index finger; pulse at wrist; arterial blood gas and catheter site
facts.attachments: Terminal branch of brachial → deep to brachioradialis → anatomical snuffbox → forms deep palmar arch

facts.function: Larger brachial terminal branch; supplies medial forearm and most of the hand
facts.attachments: Brachial artery → gives common interosseous → lateral to ulnar nerve through Guyon's canal → superficial palmar arch

facts.function: Supplies deep forearm via its interosseous branches
facts.attachments: Short branch of ulnar artery near radial tuberosity → anterior and posterior interosseous arteries

facts.function: Supplies deep anterior compartment (FPL, FDP, pronator quadratus), radius, and ulna
facts.attachments: Branch of common interosseous → on anterior interosseous membrane with AIN → pierces it distally to dorsal carpal network

facts.function: Supplies posterior (extensor) compartment of forearm
facts.attachments: Branch of common interosseous → over interosseous membrane → between superficial and deep extensors with PIN

facts.function: Contributes to elbow anastomosis posterolaterally
facts.attachments: Branch of posterior interosseous artery → ascends to anastomose with middle collateral artery

facts.function: Contributes to elbow anastomosis anterior to medial epicondyle
facts.attachments: Branch of ulnar artery → ascends to anastomose with inferior ulnar collateral artery

facts.function: Contributes to elbow anastomosis posterior to medial epicondyle
facts.attachments: Branch of ulnar artery → ascends to anastomose with superior ulnar collateral artery

facts.function: Supplies thenar muscles; often completes superficial palmar arch
facts.attachments: Arises from radial artery near wrist → through or over thenar muscles → joins superficial palmar arch

facts.function: Supplies hypothenar muscles; completes deep palmar arch
facts.attachments: Arises from ulnar artery distal to pisiform → with deep ulnar nerve between hypothenar muscles → deep arch

facts.function: Supplies fingers via common palmar digital arteries
facts.attachments: Mainly ulnar artery, completed by superficial palmar branch of radial; deep to palmar aponeurosis, distal to deep arch

facts.function: Supplies palmar metacarpal arteries, interossei, and deep palm
facts.attachments: Mainly radial artery, completed by deep palmar branch of ulnar; on metacarpal bases, proximal to superficial arch
